description: Fetch a full Pionra guide (Markdown body) by public id, or the best-matching guide for a search query. The text is returned in the requested locale when a translation exists.

lang.description: Locale for returned URLs and text: fr, en, zh, ar, pt or es. Optional — detected from the query when omitted.

query.description: Optional text query when the id is unknown.

name: get_guide
title: Get a guide
